name: numasec
description: Terminal security agent built on OpenCode, with its own AppSec probe user agent and directory fuzzer markers
seenIn: No public report of use in an attack. Covered from its source code

indicators.context: Legitimate request-collection service used to receive command output. Suspicious from production servers only numasec's interact tool falls back to webhook.site for out-of-band callbacks (FrancescoStabile/numasec).
User agent of every request numasec's appsec_probe tool sends (SQL injection, XSS, login, IDOR and CORS candidate probes), which its appsec-web-triage runbook runs
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the numasec source code

indicators.context: User agent of numasec's vulnerability-intelligence broker on the operator's host, to services.nvd.nist.gov, www.cisa.gov, api.first.org, api.osv.dev and api.github.com/advisories. HTTPS: proxy logs with TLS inspection
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the numasec source code

indicators.context: Exact user agent of numasec's page fetch tool when a Cloudflare challenge (403, cf-mitigated: challenge) blocked its first try with a Chrome 143 string. Short word: match the whole value
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the numasec source code

indicators.context: Start of the user agents numasec sends from the operator's host: numasec/<channel>/<version>/<client> to models.dev/api.json (for example numasec/latest/1.2.1/cli) and numasec/<version> to model APIs. Inherited from OpenCode with the name changed. HTTPS: proxy logs with TLS inspection
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the numasec source code

indicators.context: Path numasec's directory fuzzer requests before every run to learn what not found looks like: /numasec_404_check_<epoch milliseconds>, then a built-in wordlist with OWASP Juice Shop routes
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the numasec source code

indicators.context: XSS probe value numasec's appsec_probe puts in the first text field of an observed form or the first query parameter of a search route (GET query or JSON body); it then looks for numasec-xss in the answer
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the numasec source code

indicators.context: Identity numasec's appsec_probe POSTs as JSON to an observed login form, with the password numasec-probe
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the numasec source code

indicators.context: Request header a numasec client (numasec attach, numasec run --attach, the SDK) sends on POSTs to a numasec API server to select the working directory; GETs carry ?directory= instead. Renamed from OpenCode's x-opencode-directory
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the numasec source code

indicators.value: Penetration testing specialist. Systematic recon, enumeration, exploitation, and reporting.
indicators.context: Description of numasec's pentest agent, returned with the other agents and their prompts by GET /agent on an open numasec API server (no authentication unless NUMASEC_SERVER_PASSWORD is set)
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the numasec source code

indicators.context: Default port of the numasec API server (numasec serve, numasec acp), on 127.0.0.1 unless --hostname or --mdns is given; a random port if 4096 is taken. The same default as OpenCode and its other forks: use only with a numasec response fingerprint
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the numasec source code

indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the numasec source code

indicators.context: numasec out-of-band session store in its state folder (~/.local/state/numasec/), with interactsh or webhook.site sessions named int_<12 hex>. Generic file name: confirm with the numasec folder

indicators.context: Docker image in the numasec README (docker run -it --rm -v $PWD:/work -w /work francescostabile/numasec:latest), Alpine with Chromium and entrypoint numasec. The release workflow pushes <DOCKERHUB_USERNAME>/numasec; the Docker Hub repository did not answer the public API on November 26, 2026
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the numasec source code

indicators.context: numasec update check for installs it cannot attribute to npm, bun, pnpm, brew, scoop or choco, one second after the TUI starts (npm installs ask registry.npmjs.org/numasec/latest). HTTPS: proxy logs with TLS inspection
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the numasec source code

indicators.context: OpenCode's opencode.ai renamed in the numasec code: HTTP-Referer on OpenRouter, Vercel and ZenMux model calls, the CORS allow list of its API server, and https://numasec.ai/install, which the upgrade pipes into bash for curl installs. Ownership not verified and not contacted for this review
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the numasec source code

indicators.context: Model catalogue numasec (and OpenCode, from which it inherits the call) fetches as /api.json at start and every five minutes at most. Shared with every OpenCode-based tool: context only
